original_failures.root_cause: A fresh install has the migration-created legacy entity vector table before the explicit profile rebuild creates its 1024-dimensional manifest.
original_failures.resolution: Normal mode uses the durable entity embedding blob while no entity manifest exists; explicit-manifest and evaluation-mode paths remain fail-closed.

original_failures.observed: EMBEDDING_INDEX_MANIFEST_MISSING: vec_assertions followed by FOREIGN KEY constraint failed
original_failures.root_cause: Seed transaction rolled back durable entities when optional assertion vector indexing was unavailable.
original_failures.resolution: Normal mode defers optional assertion vector rows until explicit rebuild while retaining durable assertions; evaluation mode remains fail-closed.

original_failures.observed: Wall-clock timeout assertion was load-sensitive under Windows native module load.
original_failures.root_cause: The test measured scheduler time instead of driving the already-defined timeout contract.
original_failures.resolution: Vitest fake timers drive the existing 30ms timeout and assert the same abort/lock state.

original_failures.observed: Native sqlite/sqlite-vec initialization could produce timeout or N-API noise under parallel file workers.
original_failures.root_cause: Windows native module initialization is not deterministic across simultaneous Vitest workers.
original_failures.resolution: Windows Brain tests run with one file worker; POSIX parallelism is unchanged.

original_failures.observed: Import could begin while asynchronous onboarding demo seeding was still running; stale child processes could block restart.
original_failures.root_cause: The installed-app harness did not await the seed response and had incomplete ownership cleanup.
original_failures.resolution: The harness awaits the seed response and cleans only the E2E profile Brain PID and reserved CDP listener.

original_failures.observed: Root cli:pack:dry reported omni-context@0.1.1 instead of omctx@0.1.0-alpha.0.
original_failures.root_cause: The root script invoked npm's default pack behavior in the package directory rather than the declared pack:dry script.
original_failures.resolution: The root script delegates to packages/omctx's pack:dry script without changing package contents or dependencies.
